description: This file contains unit tests for decoding a health snapshot JSON structure within the OpenClaw project. It defines test cases verifying successful decoding of clean and noisy JSON data, as well as handling invalid JSON inputs.

classes.name: HealthDecodeTests
classes.description: A struct containing test methods for health snapshot JSON decoding.

methods.name: `decodes clean JSON`
methods.description: Test verifying successful decoding of a clean JSON payload.

methods.name: `decodes with leading noise`
methods.description: Test verifying decoding of JSON data with preceding and trailing noise.

methods.name: `fails without braces`
methods.description: Test verifying behavior when JSON data is invalid.
